input.command:
cd /tmp/obench-cell-0tdw66uw/bench_opencode_filter-js-from-html_li6lbam1 && python3 - <<'EOF'
import glob,sys,re,os
sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from filter import filter_html
files=[f for f in glob.glob('/usr/**/*.htm*',recursive=True) if os.path.isfile(f)][:400]
same=diff=0
for f in files:
    t=open(f,'rb').read().decode('utf-8','surrogateescape')
    o=filter_html(t)
    if o==t: same+=1
    else:
        diff+=1
        if not re.search(r'<script|\son\w+\s*=|javascript:',t,re.I): print('CHANGED w/o obvious JS:',f)
print('files',len(files),'unchanged',same,'changed',diff)
EOF
rm -rf .ftest
input.description: Check fidelity on real HTML files, cleanup
